description: Election Commission - Filling of a vacancy in the office of member of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Nawalapitiya Urban Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
